steps.name: accounts
steps.sql: SELECT a.name, COALESCE(SUM(i.amount_cents), 0)::int AS "paidCents" FROM accounts a JOIN plans p ON p.id = a.plan_id LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.account_id = a.id AND i.status = 'paid' WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR p.name = $1::text) GROUP BY a.id, a.name

accounts on a given plan with their tota.shapeJs: function shape(data, input) { const open = new Map(); for (const f of data.feedback) if (f.account) open.set(f.account, (open.get(f.account) ?? 0) + 1); const rows = data.accounts.map((a) => ({ name: a.name, paidCents: a.paidCents, openNegative: open.get(a.name) ?? 0 })); rows.sort((x, y) => y.openNegative - x.openNegative || y.paidCents - x.paidCents); return rows; }
assumptions: Feedback is matched to accounts by exact account name.

movie nights with each film's director a.shapeJs: function shape(data) { const byTitle = new Map(data.films.map((f) => [f.title, f])); const rows = data.nights.map((n) => { const film = byTitle.get(n.film); return { film: n.film, date: n.date, director: film ? film.director : null, runningTimeMin: film ? film.runningTimeMin : null }; }); rows.sort((x, y) => (y.date ?? '').localeCompare(x.date ?? '')); return rows; }
assumptions: Movie nights are matched to films by exact title.

films by a given director with their Rot.shapeJs: function shape(data) { return data.films.map((f) => ({ title: f.title, rtScore: f.rtScore })).sort((x, y) => y.rtScore - x.rtScore); }

steps.name: accounts
steps.sql: SELECT a.name, COALESCE(SUM(i.amount_cents), 0)::int AS "paidCents" FROM accounts a JOIN plans p ON p.id = a.plan_id LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.account_id = a.id AND i.status = 'paid' WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR p.name = $1::text) GROUP BY a.id, a.name

accounts on a given plan with their tota.shapeJs: function shape(data, input) { const rate = data.rates.find((r) => r.currency === input.currency)?.perEur; if (!rate) throw new Error(`no euro rate for ${input.currency}`); const open = new Map(); for (const f of data.feedback) if (f.account) open.set(f.account, (open.get(f.account) ?? 0) + 1); const rows = data.accounts.map((a) => ({ name: a.name, paidRevenue: Math.round(a.paidCents * rate) / 100, openNegative: open.get(a.name) ?? 0 })); rows.sort((x, y) => y.openNegative - x.openNegative || y.paidRevenue - x.paidRevenue); return rows; }
assumptions: Invoice amounts are EUR cents; revenue is converted at the latest ECB rate.
Feedback is matched to accounts by exact account name.
